proposition: Several works catalogued under Ibn Turka's name are of doubtful attribution or unidentified (a Persian jafr treatise datable after 909/1504, Makhzan al-Gharāʾib, Sharḥ al-Hidāya, Taqrīr Masʾalat al-Tawḥīd, al-Tawrāt, R. [fī] l-Wujūd, Muhayyij al-Ashwāq, Maʿjūn-i Ilāhī, and the untitled Kitāb Ṣāʾin al-Dīn ʿAlī Turka), which MK marks as mis- or possibly attributed and does not count as securely his.

mediation.who: Catalogues (Āqā Buzurg, Munzavī, Dānishpazhūh, library catalogues)
mediation.where: as cited by MK, pdf pp.170-172
mediation.note: Attributions in catalogues are often guesses.
